label: pathway-close-v2
tail:
All ten pending rows closed; three gates green.

**What changed** — seven `_pathway.md` files, ten `## <part>` sections rewritten in place (frontmatter, part slugs and page order untouched):

| part | gained pages folded in |
|---|---|
| abstract-algebra/modules | PID structure theory: aligned bases, invariant factors, elementary divisors, Smith normal form, and the abelian-group / rational-canonical / Jordan / similarity specialisations |
| abstract-algebra/sylow-and-extensions | Frattini as the nongenerators with Burnside basis; Artin fixed-field, the Galois correspondence, roots-discriminants-resolvents |
| category-theory/reflections-and-monads | Beck: free-algebra coequalizer presentations, absolute split coequalizers, strict and reflexive variants, ultrafilter-monad compact Hausdorff |
| complex-analysis/contours-and-cauchy | identity theorem, local power normal form, open mapping, max/min modulus, Hadamard three lines, holomorphic inverses |
| measure-theory/sigma-algebras-and-borel-sets | outer measures, Carathéodory, premeasure extension, sigma-finite uniqueness, regularity, metric criterion |
| number-theory/quadratic-residues | first supplement → Thue, Brahmagupta-Fibonacci, the 3 mod 4 obstruction, primitive and squarefree criteria |
| real-analysis/classical-functions | polar factorisation and the several-variable pathologies |
| real-analysis/curves-and-the-fundamental-theorems | graph-slicing volumes (disc/washer/shell/ball) and Gamma-Beta through Bohr-Mollerup, Stirling, unit-ball volume |
| real-analysis/several-variables | constant-rank normal form with Lagrange multipliers; first fundamental form, area, flux |
| topology/homotopy-and-covering-spaces | no-retraction/Brouwer, FTA, Borsuk-Ulam, abelian topological-group loops, punctured-space separation |

Each rewrite replaces the whole section rather than appending, keeps every result the old brief named, and stays under pathcheck's 120-word brief norm — my first drafts ran 240–430 words and tripped `brief-long` on all ten, so I compressed them back to 118–120.

Gates: `pathway-closure check` → 10 obligations closed and current; `pathcheck` → 0 errors, 0 warnings; `prosecheck` → 0 errors, corpus warnings 575 → 574 (none added by these edits). Claims were verified against the item files, not the page summaries — that caught two I had wrong in draft: the reciprocal-radial-phase examples are two different functions (one with unbounded partials, one with a discontinuous gradient), and the three-closed-sets result says *one of them* contains an antipodal pair.
